page.title: Kɔnɛkta
page.intro: Kɛ o adafitswaa akaunti lɛ atsa. Leads ni jɛ o adafitswaa lɛ mli lɛ baa Mi Leads lɛ mli lɛ diɛŋtsɛ, kɛ shika kɛ nyɔmɔwoo kɛha lead fɛɛ lead.

banner.connected: LinkedIn kɛ ehe tsa. Amɛmiihe mɛi ni nyiɛɔ hiɛ lɛ bianɛ - baafa nɛɛ tsakeɔ yɛ be kukuoo mli.

connect.title: Kɛ LinkedIn atsa
connect.intro: Kɛ LinkedIn akaunt ni kwɛɔ odafitswaa nɔ lɛ awo mli. Leadrat kaneɔ o adafitswaa akaunt pɛ, Lead Gen Form hiɛnyiɛlɔi kɛ adafitswaa akɔntaabuu, ni ekɛ tsakemɔi ni okɛwoɔ mli lɛ majeɔ.
connect.need1: Gbɛfaŋnɔ ko yɛ LinkedIn adafitswaa akaunt lɛ nɔ (Kwɛlɔ loo nɔ ni fe nakai).
connect.need2: Gbɛfaŋnɔ ko ni yɔɔ nitsumɔhe lɛ baafa ni akɛtsa lɛ nɔ (Nɔkwɛlɔ, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Nɔkwɛlɔ loo Nibii Amlipɛilɔ) - LinkedIn biɔ ni ekɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔi lɛ aja.
connect.need3: Sanebimɔ ni kɔɔ tɛlifoŋ nɔmba he yɛ o Lead Gen Forms nɔ - anyɛɛɛ akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni bɛ tɛlifoŋ nɔmba afata he.

connection.noPermission: Obaanyɛ okwɛ baafa nɛɛ. Hegbɛ ni akɛtsakeɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ he miihia "Kwɛmɔ gbɛjianɔtoo lɛ nɔ" hegbɛ.

Kɛ enɛ atsu nii kɛha gbɛtsɔɔmɔi ni jɛ dani okɛ ohe wo mli, loo ni okwɛ be ko ekoŋŋ (kɛyashi gbii 90 yɛ be kome mli). Akɛ hiɛnyiɛlɔi ni yɔɔ Leadrat mli momo lɛ shwieɔ shi.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Kɛɛmɔ LinkedIn mɔ ni nyiɛɔ ehiɛ lɛ batsɔ gbɛkpamɔi diɛŋtsɛ. Kɛji LinkedIn hiɛnyiɛlɔ ko shɛ shihilɛ ko ni ohala yɛ shishigbɛ lɛ he lɛ, Leadrat bɔɔ he amaniɛ etsɔɔ LinkedIn , no hewɔ lɛ ogbɛjianɔtoo lɛ he amaniɛbɔɔ lɛ tsɔɔ hiɛnyiɛlɔ kpakpa ni LinkedIn baanyɛ ana mɛi babaoo ni sumɔɔ ohiɛnyiɛlɔi ni hi fe fɛɛ lɛ. LinkedIn hiɛnyiɛlɔ ID lɛ kɛ gbɛ kome hash ni yɔɔ email lɛ mli lɛ pɛ ji nɔ ni akɛmajeɔ.
capi.created: Tsakemɔ ni afee yɛ LinkedIn nɔ ni atsɔɔ he mfoniri.

activity.title: Nifeemɔ wolo
